narrative:
Garfield-Heights municipal court district has 56,213 registered voters, with 56.3% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 11.7% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 32.0%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 20.2 percentage points. Registration is trending redder in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean +8.2% D−R vs +25.7% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
